sourcePassages.text: CARRE was a research project on personalized patient empowerment and shared decision making for cardiorenal disease and comorbidities. I contributed at Democritus University of Thrace from 2014 to 2016.

sourcePassages.title: CARRE
sourcePassages.text: This work connects healthcare informatics, semantic technologies, and practical application development. It provides experience in structuring domain information and building the software used to enter and aggregate it.

sourcePassages.title: CARRE
sourcePassages.text: My work covered the Risk Data Entry System V2, development of the Educational Resources Ontology, and the Educational Data Aggregator. These contributions combined application development with the representation and aggregation of healthcare educational information.
